# FDG3037

> DO NOT introduce type name conflicts between types in technology namespaces and an application model namespace (unless the technology is not expected to be used with the application model).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.4.1.4 Technology Namespace Groups.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

A technology namespace group is all namespaces with the same first two parts (`<Company>.<Technology>*`), such as Microsoft.Build.Utilities and Microsoft.Build.Tasks. Application model namespaces are groups rarely used with other application models, such as `System.Windows*` and `System.Web.UI*`.

## From the book

For example, you should not add a type named `Binding` to the `Microsoft.VisualBasic` namespace because the `System.Windows.Forms` namespace already contains that type name.
